pages.text: The good way into your soul is to sit down somewhere you chose and go.$(p)Stand on or beside a $(item)Meditation Cushion$(0) and hold [$(k:key.soulhome.meditate)]. After about 3 seconds you are in your soul - faster than any key, and the body you leave behind takes only half of any hit it is dealt.
pages.title: Meditation

pages.text: Meditation needs a cushion. That is the point of it: a cushion is where you decided to leave your body, and a cushion in a locked room is a body nobody can reach.$(p)Move, or be hit, and the channel stops. Nobody steps out of a fight by meditating.$(p)The same bind brings you back from anywhere in your soul, with no cushion needed.
Wool and string - nothing you would miss.
pages.title: Meditation Cushion
